name: bu_Ga6N6
title: GaN (Ga6N6) crystal
description: Variable-cell crystal-structure prediction of GaN with six formula units (12 atoms) per cell. Experimental ground state: wurtzite (P6_3mc); zinc blende (~10 meV/atom higher in DFT), the 6H polytype and the high-pressure rocksalt phase compete. NEP89 caveat: NEP89 puts zinc blende 33 meV/atom below wurtzite (wrong polytype ordering), so its global minimum is zinc blende. Artefact screening: NEP89 has an N-N bonded collapsed hole (N-N 1.17 A, Ga-Ga 2.02 A, 12-fold Ga, 2.7 eV below zinc blende), found by symmetry-constrained random search. An N-N guard floor of 1.9 A (guard_pairs; physical N-N >= 3.1 A) lifts it by 46 eV and leaves the physical minima unchanged.
